newsitem.title: USA: Cross-Continent Auto gets $75 mln facility.
newsitem.headline: Cross-Continent Auto gets $75 mln facility.

text.p: Cross-Continent Auto Retailers Inc said Monday it obtained a three-year $75 million revolving credit facility with Chase Manhattan Corp's Texas Commerce Bank division in Houston.
The company, which expects to close the facility late this month, will use the funds for acquisitions of car dealerships, working capital, capital expenditures and reduction of debt.
Under the agreement, Chase Securities underwrites $40 million of the credit line while the remaining $35 million is subject to syndication on a best-efforts basis.
Cross Continent Auto owns and operates franchised car dealerships in Texas, Oklahoma, Nevada and Colorado.
